items.text: Saints RB Travis Etienne will go on Injured Reserve, coach Kellen Moore. He’s dealing with a hamstring injury.
items.implication: Season-long impact minimal but multi-week absence confirmed.

items.text: Rico Dowdle ruled OUT for TNF vs Browns (toe); enables full workhorse for Jaylen Warren.

Jaylen Warren on the LOVE list as a top 10 play this week. RBs off big usage on short week sometimes disappoint but believe in him tonight with Dowdle out; led with 90% snaps and 20/22 RB touches last week.
items.why: Workhorse role locked with Dowdle OUT; CLE allows 88+ yards to RBs every game.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start on TNF; high floor volume.
items.opportunity: Near-100% snap share, high carry/target volume

items.text: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full on Ravens Thursday injury report.
items.implication: Both expected to play without restriction; Flowers high-upside WR.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay told reporters that he expects WR Puka Nacua, who has had a groin injury, to play Sunday vs. the Eagles. Nacua limited in practice Wednesday.
items.why: McVay expectation after limited practice and progress on groin/hip.
items.implication: Elite WR1 if active; monitor full practices for confirmation.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share return vs Eagles

items.text: No practice today for WR Justin Jefferson, whom the team considers day to day due to his ankle injury.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday; high risk if limited.

items.text: De’Von Achane officially out for the season after torn ACL vs Chiefs; top waiver priority Ollie Gordon/Jaylen Wright.
items.implication: MIA RB committee opens; top waivers.

items.text: Breece Hall week-to-week (quad); Braelon Allen top waiver as workhorse. Achane=Gordon/Wright; Etienne=Kamara/Miller among injury beneficiaries.
items.why: Hall injury opens full snaps for Allen.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: averaged 35% target share and 104 yards/game with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194). NO allows 5th-most TDs to WRs.
items.why: Penix return unlocks high target share; strong matchup.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; Wilson 36% target share last time Mitchell sidelined. 78% catch rate, CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Teammate absence boosts target share; favorable defense.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate dropped to 42% W3, only 13% third downs. SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor usage profile + tough run defense matchup.

items.text: DeVonta Smith sidelined again Thursday with hamstring; similar to prior week management. Monitor for Eagles vs Rams.
items.implication: Risk of limited or out; Goedert already out MCL.
items.opportunity: If out, more targets to Brown/Wicks

items.text: Fresh ROS rankings live: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall. Notable: Parker Washington 22, Saquon Barkley 30, Matthew Golden 40. Prefer JT side in Flowers+Montgomery for JT trade.
items.why: Updated post-Week 3 usage and opportunity analysis.
items.implication: Walker elite RB1 ROS; high on certain mid-tier breakouts.
